title: TrashCans issue #56: [Crash] Client CTD when Clicking History Button
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (none) does not cover issue text
text:
[issue by Sandriell]
### Minecraft version

1.20.1

### Mod Loader

Forge

### Trash Cans version

trashcans-1.1.0-forge-mc1.20.4

### Game environment

Client

### Steps to reproduce

Simply clicking on the little arrow on the right side of the UI, which I assume is the new deleted history, crashes the client to desktop.

### Crash report (~/logs/latest.log)

https://gist.github.com/Sandriell/ccc4a0f3a29841b2bbe6215e48797265

[comment by SuperMartijn642 (owner)]
It seems ForgeGradle was obfuscating `CustomSlot#isActive` to `Slot#isActive`, despite `CustomSlot` just being an interface on its own. This meant it breaks anything trying to call `CustomSlot#isActive` outside of dev.

It should be fixed now in version 1.1.24a of my core library.
Thank you for reporting the issue!
